answer: To act, each agent must BURN a small fixed coin, not lock it — the burn is destroyed and leaves a permanent on-ledger receipt, a river of proofs no cipher can reverse or forge. Because the cost is annihilated rather than staked, it never compounds back into usable balance: every identity pays again from zero. One honest agent spends a single pearl of cost per action; a sybil minting 1000 clones burns 1000 separate pearls it never recovers, so duplication meets a hard per-head floor that capturing any verdict can never out-earn.
